## Assumptions and decisions

- Columns are lon, lat, t (verified: lon in [-180,180], lat in [-90,90] for all trips).
- Each trip is projected with a local equirectangular projection (see pathsnap/geo.py).
- Arcs are straight segments between their nodes; duplicate arcs are merged to a canonical id.
- Observation labels come from a monotone DP alignment of the track to the reference route (pathsnap/labels.py); observations farther than labels.max_label_distance_m are unlabelled.
- The reference route is treated as reference information, not verified ground truth (routes with disconnected arcs above are evidence of its limitations).
